findingDisposition.rootCause: The final runner and workload require caller-injected callbacks, while no existing approved managed lifecycle exposes the required parameterized final-run contract.
findingDisposition.prevention: Do not claim final dynamic readiness from static callback unit tests; require a single owned adapter contract before enabling runtime authority.

nextAuthorizedDesignNeed: A follow-on implementation-facing design/package must explicitly own the final managed adapter and any necessary change to the existing managed runner public contract; it must be independently reviewed before dynamic execution.
